turns.user_text: When does the Dragon Bridge fire and water show happen?
turns.asr_transcript: When does the Dragon Bridge fire and water show happen?
turns.agent_answer: Weekendevenings around 9:00 PM on Saturday and Sunday. Arrive early for a good spot!

turns.topic: Di chuyển & Chuẩn bị hành lý Bà Nà Hills
turns.user_text: How do I get to Ba Na Hills from the city, and what should I bring?
turns.asr_transcript: How do I get to Ba Na Hills from the city and what should I bring?
turns.agent_answer: Take a25 to 40 minute taxi. Bring a thin layer for coolermountain weather and comfortable clothes for the resort.

turns.agent_answer: Entry isfree! Dress modestly by covering your shoulders and knees.

turns.user_text: Can I find vegetarian food in Da Nang, and what local word should I say to ask for it?
turns.asr_transcript: Can I find vegetarian food in Da Nang and what local words should I say to ask for it?
turns.agent_answer: Yes,find vegetarian food near pagodas and city center. Say chay for vegetarian or Buddhist-style food.

turns.topic: Thời tiết mùa khô tắm biển
turns.user_text: What is the best time of year to visit Da Nang for dry beach weather?
turns.asr_transcript: What is the best time of year to visit Da Nang for dry beach weather?
turns.agent_answer: February toAugust is the best drier period for beach weather with warmer temperatures and great swimming conditions.

turns.topic: So sánh khu vực ở Biển Mỹ Khê vs Trung tâm Sông Hàn
turns.user_text: Should I stay near My Khe beach or near the Han River city center?
turns.asr_transcript: Should I stay near my Ki beach or near the Han River city center?
turns.agent_answer: Choose MyKhe for beach swims, or the Han River for city energy, restaurants, and DragonBridge shows.
